description: Defines ASN.1 structures and message types for 3GPP NR RRC protocol, specifically for DL-DCCH messages including message type choices and sequence structures.

classes.name: dl_dcch_msg_type_c
classes.description: Represents the choice of DL-DCCH message types, including various RRC message options.

classes.name: dl_dcch_msg_s
classes.description: Sequence structure encapsulating the DL-DCCH message with its message type.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the message type for dl_dcch_msg_type_c.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the message into bit stream.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the message from bit stream.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Converts the message to JSON format.
